```{r setup}
#! include: false

library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_family = "sans"))

output_dir <- here("figures")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Colour Brewer paired palette
colour_brewer <- setNames(append(as.list(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")), c("#737373", "#FFFFFF", "#000000")), c("blue", "darkblue", "green", "darkgreen", "red", "darkred", "orange", "darkorange", "purple", "darkpurple", "yellow", "brown", "grey", "white", "black"))
# Paul Tol's vibrant palette - colourblind friendly
vibrant_colours <- c("#CC3311", "#0077BB", "#009988", "#EE3377", "#EE7733", "#33BBEE")
# Paul Tol's muted palette - plus 3 extras
muted_colours <- c("#882255", "#332288", "#DDCC77", "#117733", "#88CCEE", "#CC6677", "#44AA99", "#999933", "#AA4499", "#BBBBBB", "#EE7733", "#CC3311")
# Paul Tol's bright palette - colourblind friendly
bright_colours <- c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44", "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB")

# galah_reference (galah's dedicated --reference-genomes mode) is treated as
# its own tool rather than a ref=TRUE variant of "galah", since it's a
# different run to galah_globdb (which just concatenates inputs).
tool_levels <- c("galah", "galah_low_memory", "skder_greedy", "drep_skani", "pyani_ANIm", "galah_reference")
tool_labels <- c("galah", "galah (low memory)", "skder (greedy)", "dRep (skani)", "pyani (ANIm)", "galah (reference)")
tool_colours <- setNames(vibrant_colours[seq_len(length(tool_labels))], tool_labels)
```

```{r wrangling}
genomes_metadata <- read_tsv("/work/microbiome/ibis/SRA_genomes/compiled/genome_metadata.tsv") %>%
  filter(completeness - 5 * contamination >= 50)

benchmarking_root <- here("results")

# Total genomes in the GlobDB r232 reference set, added to every sample in
# the reference-based (GlobDB) runs.
n_ref_genomes <- 346233

benchmarking <- list.files(here(benchmarking_root, "benchmarks"), recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    raw_tool = str_extract(value, "(?<=benchmarks/)[^/]+"),
    # "_globdb" directories are the same tool clustered together with the
    # GlobDB reference set; galah_reference is kept as-is (see tool_levels).
    ref = str_detect(raw_tool, "_globdb$") | raw_tool == "galah_reference",
    tool = str_remove(raw_tool, "_globdb$"),
    size = str_extract(value, "(?<=cluster_)[^_]+") %>% as.integer(),
    rep = str_extract(value, "(?<=_rep)[^.]+") %>% as.integer(),
    data = map(value, ~ read_tsv(.x, col_types = cols(`h:m:s` = col_character())))
    ) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  select(tool, ref, size, rep, s, cpu_time, max_rss, max_vms)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cluster counts: derive the number of clusters formed by each tool's run from
# its raw output (rather than a summary file), since each tool reports its
# clustering result in a different format.
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
count_galah_clusters <- function(path) {
  f <- file.path(path, "clusters.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(f) || file.size(f) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  reps <- read_tsv(f, col_names = c("rep", "member"), col_types = "c_", show_col_types = FALSE)$rep
  n_distinct(reps)
}

count_drep_clusters <- function(path) {
  d <- file.path(path, "dereplicated_genomes")
  if (!dir.exists(d)) return(NA_integer_)
  n <- length(list.files(d))
  if (n == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  n
}

count_skder_clusters <- function(path) {
  d <- file.path(path, "skder", "Dereplicated_Representative_Genomes")
  if (!dir.exists(d)) return(NA_integer_)
  n <- length(list.files(d))
  if (n == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  n
}

count_pyani_clusters <- function(path) {
  f <- file.path(path, "classify", "ANIm_classify.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NA_integer_)
  n <- length(read_lines(f)) - 1
  if (n <= 0) return(NA_integer_)
  n
}

input_genomes <- read_tsv("/work/microbiome/ibis/SRA_genomes/compiled/genome_metadata.tsv") %>%
  filter(completeness - 5 * contamination >= 50) %>%
  pull(name)

count_galah_clusters_ref <- function(path) {
  f <- file.path(path, "clusters.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(f) || file.size(f) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  reps <- read_tsv(f, col_names = c("rep", "member"), col_types = "cc", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(genome_name = str_extract(member, "(?<=/)[^/]+(?=.fna)")) %>%
    filter(genome_name %in% input_genomes) %>%
    pull(rep)

  n_distinct(reps)
}

count_clusters <- function(ref, tool, path) {
  if (ref) {
    switch(tool,
      galah = , galah_low_memory = , galah_reference = count_galah_clusters_ref(path),
      NA_integer_
    )
  } else {
    switch(tool,
      galah = , galah_low_memory = , galah_reference = count_galah_clusters(path),
      drep_skani = count_drep_clusters(path),
      skder_greedy = count_skder_clusters(path),
      pyani_ANIm = count_pyani_clusters(path),
      NA_integer_
    )
  }
}

clusters <- tibble(raw_tool = list.dirs(benchmarking_root, recursive = FALSE) %>% basename()) %>%
  mutate(tool_dir = file.path(benchmarking_root, raw_tool)) %>%
  mutate(cluster_dir = map(tool_dir, ~ list.dirs(.x, recursive = FALSE))) %>%
  unnest(cluster_dir) %>%
  filter(str_detect(basename(cluster_dir), "^cluster_")) %>%
  mutate(
    ref = str_detect(raw_tool, "_globdb$") | raw_tool == "galah_reference",
    tool = str_remove(raw_tool, "_globdb$"),
    size = str_extract(basename(cluster_dir), "(?<=cluster_)[^_]+") %>% as.integer(),
    rep = str_extract(basename(cluster_dir), "(?<=_rep)[^.]+") %>% as.integer(),
    n_clusters = pmap_int(list(ref, tool, cluster_dir), count_clusters)
    ) %>%
  select(tool, ref, size, rep, n_clusters)

clusters_average <- clusters %>%
  group_by(ref, size, rep) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_n   = mean(n_clusters, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

clusters_summary <- clusters %>%
  left_join(clusters_average, by = c("ref", "size", "rep")) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_diff = 1 + (n_clusters - mean_n) / mean_n
  ) %>%
  group_by(tool, ref) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_n   = mean(prop_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_n     = sd(prop_diff,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(prop_diff))),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tool = factor(tool, levels = tool_levels, labels = tool_labels)
  )
```

```{r stats}
# Range of walltime and memory usage for 50,000 genomes
benchmarking %>%
  filter(!ref, size == 50000) %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    min_walltime = min(s, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    max_walltime = max(s, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    min_memory   = min(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024,
    max_memory   = max(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_walltime))

# Range of walltime and memory usage for 10,000 genomes
benchmarking %>%
  filter(!ref, size == 10000) %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    min_walltime = min(s, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    max_walltime = max(s, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    min_memory   = min(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024,
    max_memory   = max(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_walltime))

# Range of walltime and memory usage for 50,000 genomes with GlobDB reference
benchmarking %>%
  filter(ref, size == 50000) %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    min_walltime = min(s, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    max_walltime = max(s, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    min_memory   = min(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024,
    max_memory   = max(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_walltime))

# Summary of cluster counts
clusters_summary %>%
  arrange(ref, desc(mean_n))
```

## Benchmarking

```{r benchmarking}
output_subdir <- here(output_dir, "benchmarking")
dir.create(output_subdir, recursive = TRUE)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: complete grid of all tool × size combinations
# NA in any metric = tool did not finish at that size
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
size_levels <- sort(unique(benchmarking$size))

bench_summary <- benchmarking %>%
  filter(!ref) %>%
  # Complete the grid so missing tool×size combos become explicit NAs
  complete(tool, size) %>%
  group_by(tool, size) %>%
  summarise(
    finished     = any(!is.na(s)),
    mean_s       = mean(s,        na.rm = TRUE),
    se_s         = sd(s,          na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(s))),
    mean_cpu     = mean(cpu_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cpu       = sd(cpu_time,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(cpu_time))),
    mean_rss     = mean(max_rss,  na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rss       = sd(max_rss,    na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(max_rss))),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tool = factor(tool, levels = tool_levels, labels = tool_labels),
    size = factor(size, levels = size_levels)
  )

# Rows where the tool did not finish — used for N/A annotations
bench_na <- bench_summary %>% filter(!finished)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared helper to add N/A text at the base of missing bars
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
na_annotation <- function(na_df) {
  if (nrow(na_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  geom_text(
    data     = na_df,
    aes(x = tool, y = 0, label = "N/A"),
    vjust    = -0.4,
    size     = 2,
    colour   = "grey40",
    fontface = "italic",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
}

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wall-clock time (seconds)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_bench_time <- bench_summary %>%
  filter(finished) %>%
  ggplot(aes(tool, mean_s / 3600, fill = tool)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = (mean_s - se_s) / 3600, ymax = (mean_s + se_s) / 3600),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  na_annotation(bench_na) +
  facet_wrap(~ size, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tool_colours) +
  xlab("Tool") +
  ylab("Wall-clock time (h)") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank())
p_bench_time
ggsave(here(output_subdir, "bench_time.png"), p_bench_time, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)
ggsave(here(output_subdir, "bench_time.svg"), p_bench_time, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CPU time (seconds)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_bench_cpu <- bench_summary %>%
  filter(finished) %>%
  ggplot(aes(tool, mean_cpu / 3600, fill = tool)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = (mean_cpu - se_cpu) / 3600, ymax = (mean_cpu + se_cpu) / 3600),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  na_annotation(bench_na) +
  facet_wrap(~ size, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tool_colours) +
  xlab("Tool") +
  ylab("CPU time (h)") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank())
p_bench_cpu
ggsave(here(output_subdir, "bench_cpu.png"), p_bench_cpu, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)
ggsave(here(output_subdir, "bench_cpu.svg"), p_bench_cpu, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Peak memory (max RSS, converted MB → GB)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_bench_mem <- bench_summary %>%
  filter(finished) %>%
  ggplot(aes(tool, mean_rss / 1024, fill = tool)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = (mean_rss - se_rss) / 1024,
        ymax = (mean_rss + se_rss) / 1024),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  na_annotation(bench_na) +
  facet_wrap(~ size, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tool_colours) +
  xlab("Tool") +
  ylab("Peak memory (GB)") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank())
p_bench_mem
ggsave(here(output_subdir, "bench_mem.png"), p_bench_mem, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)
ggsave(here(output_subdir, "bench_mem.svg"), p_bench_mem, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)
```

## Reference-based benchmarking (GlobDB)

```{r benchmarking-globdb}
output_subdir_globdb <- here(output_dir, "benchmarking_globdb")
dir.create(output_subdir_globdb, recursive = TRUE)

bench_summary_globdb <- benchmarking %>%
  filter(ref) %>%
  # Complete the grid so missing tool×size combos become explicit NAs
  complete(tool, size) %>%
  group_by(tool, size) %>%
  summarise(
    finished     = any(!is.na(s)),
    mean_s       = mean(s,        na.rm = TRUE),
    se_s         = sd(s,          na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(s))),
    mean_cpu     = mean(cpu_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cpu       = sd(cpu_time,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(cpu_time))),
    mean_rss     = mean(max_rss,  na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rss       = sd(max_rss,    na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(max_rss))),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tool = factor(tool, levels = tool_levels, labels = tool_labels),
    size = factor(size, levels = size_levels)
  )

# Rows where the tool did not finish — used for N/A annotations
bench_na_globdb <- bench_summary_globdb %>% filter(!finished)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wall-clock time (seconds)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  filter(finished) %>%
```

### Cluster counts

```{r benchmarking-clusters}
output_subdir_clusters <- here(output_dir, "clusters")
dir.create(output_subdir_clusters, recursive = TRUE)

p_clusters <- clusters_summary %>%
  filter(!ref) %>%
  ggplot(aes(tool, mean_n, fill = tool)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_n - se_n, ymax = mean_n + se_n),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = 1),
    linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tool_colours) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.9, NA)) +
  xlab("Tool") +
  ylab("Normalised cluster count") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank())
p_clusters
ggsave(here(output_subdir_clusters, "benchmarking_clusters.png"), p_clusters, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)
```
